title: Schedule: Share of an Increase Given Back to Loyal and Settled Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement Tenants
content:
**Retention share by tenure and late-fee record — Vehicle, RV & Boat Parking Agreement.** In a retention concession, the share of the increase given back is:

- **55%** for a tenant who has held the agreement at least the loyalty tenure of the class and on whose agreement no more than 2 late fees posted in the last 12 months stand without a billing-error correction credit;
- **52%** for a tenant who has held it at least the minimum retention tenure of the class but less than the loyalty tenure, and on whose agreement no more than 1 such late fee stands;
- for every other tenant, no adjustment under this schedule.

| Space class | Loyalty tenure | Minimum retention tenure |
|---|---|---|
| Bluegate Uncovered Car Space | 36 months | 12 months |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 36 months | 12 months |
| Bluegate Uncovered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 36 months | 12 months |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (up to 30 ft) | 36 months | 12 months |
| Bluegate Covered RV & Boat Space (31-45 ft) | 36 months | 12 months |
| Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage | 24 months | 6 months |

**Counting.** Tenure is in whole calendar months from the start date to the handling date, to the same day of the later month. The late fees that stand without a billing-error correction credit are the late fees posted on the agreement in the window less the billing-error correction credits posted on it in the window. A window of the last 12 months covers entries dated less than 12 whole calendar months before the handling date, whole months being counted to the same day of the later month.

**Combinations (uncovered and covered classes).**

| Months held | Uncorrected late fees in window | Share under this schedule |
|---|---|---|
| 36 or more | 0 to 2 | 55% |
| 36 or more | 3 or more | no adjustment |
| 12 to 35 | 0 or 1 | 52% |
| 12 to 35 | 2 or more | no adjustment |
| under 12 | any | no adjustment |

For the Bluegate Enclosed Vehicle Garage read 24 for 36 and 6 for 12. Hypothetical: a garage tenant at 30 months with 2 uncorrected late fees receives 55%; a covered-space tenant at 30 months with 2 receives no adjustment.
